quests.title: Mineral Research: Moonfall Silver

dialogue.sit: (Hmm... seems like it's not starting yet.)
(There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogue.t: Dorota? What are you doing here?
You couldn't have come at a better time, Linnea! I was just telling everyone about the wonders of Moonfall Silver.
Oh, Moonfall Silver, Moonfall Silver... is there any gem more perfect in the sublunary sphere?
Look! Its flawless form, its smooth, rounded texture! And that iridescent white paired with unrivaled elemental affinity!
In my eyes, only the moon in the sky can compare to you!
Umm... yeah. Moonfall Silver is a beautiful ore. I've collected a few samples myself.
See, I knew you'd understand!
But still, no one understands Moonfall Silver better than I do! Even if you're an advisor to the Adventurers' Guild, I'm not giving up first place that easily. Hehe.
Right! And since you're usually the one teaching adventurers, how about I test you for a change?
I have three pieces of Moonfall Silver here. Sadly, two of them have minor flaws. The last one, though, that's my prized treasure. The Moonfall Silver among Moonfall Silvers!
Can you tell which one is the most perfect?
Let me see...
(Hmm? What is Lumi doing?)
Haha, looks like even you can misjudge sometimes, Linnea. This one actually has a tiny flaw hidden in a very inconspicuous spot.
Okay, you got me. But next time, I'm not going down that easily!
Fine by me. I'm always ready!

dialogue.sit: Linnea ends up taking part in Dorota's Moonfall Silver Appreciation Event, and had a really lovely time...

dialogue.t: Wow, didn't expect everyone to be so enthusiastic. It's a shame moments like this never seem to last... Alright, time to pack up and head back.
Let me help you.
Oh, that'd be nice! Thanks!
"If you've ever been captivated by the iridescent glow of Moonfall Silver, join us and become a member of the Moonfall Silver Appreciation Society!"
Whew... we didn't miss any, right?
Hmm... nope, everything's just right!
I saw you making those fun patterns on the ground with Moonfall Silver.
Yeah! It took quite a bit of effort, but I think it really helped to spark everyone's love for the Moonfall Silver.
Speaking of which, I heard that there's a folk tale from Natlan...
It's about a girl who originally lived among the stars. When she fell to the earth, she left huge drawings on the ground in her effort to return to the sky.
In the end, her father, the sun up in the heavens, saw her request and brought her back.
Maybe he'd see the patterns you made and become a fan of Moonfall Silver too!
Haha, if that's the case, then I'd be the ultimate Moonfall Silver ambassador!
But compared to that, I'm still more worried about getting noticed by birds from above. You know, crows and all, they really like shiny things too.
True. And besides crows, we've also got to watch out for Sniffer Moles and Weasel Thieves on the ground.
And Lumi too!
Haha, right! And Lumi too!
Ya-ho?
Anyway, thanks for helping out earlier. Even though this is just a small portion of my collection... here, take them! Consider it a gift for Lumi.
Hehe, today's a really lucky day, isn't it, Lumi?
Ya-hoho!
If they were crafted into artisanal pieces, wouldn't they be more of a hit...?

quests.description: There appears to be some kind of event taking place in the plaza of Nasha Town…
